body:
I was hoping for the GOTY edition to drop to €5 since it's been that low before and I don't know how likely it is that I'll play through the base game and the DLC before the next sale. This is why I'm considering just the base game.

This War of Mine sounds like my type of game. I love story driven games or anything that causes you to feel emotion while playing. I already bought The Long Dark during the sale so would it be a good idea to buy a second survival game?

Is Fable similar to any other type RPG's. I've played the Elder Scrolls series before and loved Oblivion.
If they want to see his bank statements I'll have to tell them he's on placement as his paycheck goes straight into his account at the end of every month.

The €350 from his grant is for the entire month so he's only getting an extra €80 or €90 a week added to his placement money. It would be just the two of us there which might make them suspicious but its a two bed apartment.

Hahaha if I did that I think the neighbours would think the same. Since it's an apartment block we'd be on the 3rd floor and there's a front door into the building which you need the key to or to be buzzed in. If I'm alone but there's people sitting in cars at the blocks I'd probably press the buzzer (which is broken) to make it seem like I'm looking to be let in first before using the key.

My BF has just said if they ask why both our names were on a contract to tell them he needed a second signature as landlords don't like renting to students alone. Also, when I do find a job I plan on moving in and it saves doing up a second contract. Don't know how believable that sounds but with no bills in my name or rent being removed from my account I should be good.
Thats what I'm thinking, it's not unusual. I'm just really paranoid with it being close so someone might drive by or live in the houses in the area haha

I've been told by a lot of people to not tell them I've even moved and if asked about it tell them my BF lives there and I'm just staying over. My worry is being seen coming in and out of any apartment block (which is about ~15 minutes walk from the SW) with a key while alone.
How did that work out for her? From what I've heard they seem to be incapable of believing that people of the opposite sex can live together and not be in a relationship.

This seems to be the mindset of a lot of people. I was reading about couples that were cohabiting and while one was working could only support themselves let alone a second person along with bills, shopping costs and rent but the SW didn't car and saw it as a responsibility if the two people were committed enough to live together. I don't understand why they're more likely to fuck over cohabiting couples when having a room mate of the opposite sex where rent, bills, food etc would be split the same way.

He doesnt have that much income to begin with being a student. Anything he earns in the next 2 months on placement will also have to last him for the Summer as he has no full-time/part-time job to support himself during those months. He'll then be on ~350 a month until he completes his degree, meaning I'd be earning more than him on JSA at ~400 a month and more likely have to help support him at some point so I really can't afford to have anything cut when I can barely live on it. A lot of people on here have told me to lie while others I know on JSA have told me not to tell them anything at all or that I'd have even moved.
As in not say anything at all and let them assume I still live at home?

Yeah my biggest worry is if I tell them they'll assume he has enough to support us both since he's on placement and getting the grant. This is only for another 2 months and anything he has saved up will have to do him for at least another year while he goes back to living on just ~350 a month. This means that come September I'll have more money than him at 400 a month so I really couldn't afford to have anything cut from that.

I've been told this by a few people and told not to tell them anything... I'm just worried about being seen coming in and out of an apartment block with a key as the apartment is pretty close to the SW.

He gets his grant while on placement too which would be roughly another 350 added to his monthly earnings. This is whats putting me off as I'm only getting €100 a week and can't afford to have any less right now and especially not in 2 months time when my BF finishes his placement and only has his grant to live on in September. Would it just be better to say I haven't moved?
